title: B-tree Pager and stable filename observations

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreePager, sqlite3BtreeGetFilename, and sqlite3BtreeGetJournalname expose the B-tree's Pager owner and its stable database and rollback-journal names.
excluded_responsibilities: Pager opening, closing, and filename allocation

external_source_responsibilities: Database.open owns a valid embedded Pager
Pager owns stable database and rollback-journal filename allocations
dependencies.caller_closure: All three complete accessors and their generated blocks are assigned; native B-tree traversal tests observe exact Pager and filename identity.

outputs: Borrowed Pager pointer or borrowed sentinel-terminated filename
contracts.ownership: Pure borrowed observations; no allocation or ownership transfer.
contracts.state_and_results: pagerOwner returns the exact embedded Pager. filename delegates to Pager.databaseName(true), which returns an empty string for memory-backed databases. journalFilename returns the allocated rollback-journal name independently of file-open state.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No locks, callbacks, or I/O because Pager and names remain invariant while Database is open.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Infallible for an initialized live Database.

representation_differences: The production B-tree owner is Database with an embedded Pager rather than source Btree/BtShared pointer layers.
Zig returns sentinel slices whose lifetime is tied to Database instead of raw const char pointers.

oracle.protocol: Open a named database through the native B-tree owner, require pagerOwner pointer identity with the embedded Pager, and compare the database and journal names before opening a rollback journal.
oracle.normalization: Compare owner pointer identity and exact filename bytes.

assurance.oom: Observers allocate nothing; Database/Pager construction owns allocation failures.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Observers perform no I/O and rely on open-owner lifetime invariants.
assurance.malformed_input: Typed live Database input prevents absent Pager state.
assurance.continuation: Pure observations preserve B-tree and Pager state.

integration.production_owner: src/core/btree.zig Database with embedded src/core/pager.zig Pager
integration.native_call_path: Database construction embeds Pager; filename observers delegate to Pager-owned stable names used by B-tree and connection-facing storage paths.

independent_review.notes: Requires memory-backed B-tree trace, pinned-C comparison, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Add a direct native B-tree memory-backed filename trace.

implementation_spans: src/core/btree.zig Database ownership/open/test path and src/core/pager.zig filename accessors were reviewed
callers: Source pragma, main, vacuum, backup, status, VDBE, and extension paths consume sqlite3BtreePager
Source vacuum, pragma, main, and VDBE paths consume the filename observations
Native B-tree accessor test consumes all three Zig declarations
assertions_branches_cleanup: Both source filename functions assert a valid Pager owner
Memory-backed filename is the only output branch
upstream_tests: Upstream pragma, vacuum, and filename APIs exercise these observations
Project B-tree and Pager tests exercise named owner/name identity
